## What the exit templates mean
-# Six rules, replayed on every contract. The report always names the one that would have paid best.
```
lock10         −36%  Sell the first print at +10%.
lock25        −100%  Sell the first print at +25%.
lock50        −100%  Sell the first print at +50%.
trail15/25     −36%  Arm once +15% prints, then sell when the contract gives back 25% from its peak.
trail30/30     −30%  Arm at +30%, sell on a 30% give-back from peak.
hold EOD      −100%  Hold to the 16:00 close.
```
-# Right column: realized on META put 09:15 · homer. Every template stops at −30% or at the close, whichever comes first. The hold row is the only place the close appears. Payoff tiers 10 / 50, the 30% realizable stop, risk cuts −10 / −30 and the ER cuts 0.2 / 0.5 are provisional thresholds pending ledger calibration.
